title: Friday (11) on the Campaign Trail: Presidential Candidates' Schedules
subtitle: Presidential candidates took part in candidate forums, media interviews, TV tapings, and campaign rallies this past Friday.
excerpt: On Friday (11), presidential candidates' schedules featured media interviews, TV tapings, candidate forums, and campaign rallies ahead of the vote.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The campaign trail on Friday (11) was marked by routine election activities for presidential candidates, who participated in candidate forums, media interviews, and television tapings.

In addition to media appearances, the contenders also held campaign rallies, working to raise the profile of their platforms among voters.

These activities are part of the official electoral calendar, which provides designated windows for candidates to present their positions and engage directly with the public ahead of the election. The campaign period is governed by regulations that set the rules and frequency for candidate appearances across news media and public events.

With information from Agência Brasil.
